dmp3099l.src: Diodes DMP3099L DS36081 Rev. 5-2 (May 2025), page 2 and Figure 7
dmp3099l.vgs_th_hot_note: DD/E: Figure 7 (typical, -250 uA) falls from about 1.76 V at 25 C to 1.57 V at 100 C and 1.35 V at 150 C, about -2.6 mV/K; applied to the -1.0 V minimum: -0.81 V at 100 C, -0.73 V at 125 C

2n3904.src: onsemi 2N3903/D Rev. 9 (Aug 2021): hFE min 40 at 0.1 mA, 70 at 1 mA; VCE(sat) 0.2 V max and VBE(sat) 0.65 to 0.85 V at 10 mA / 1 mA; ICEX 50 nA max at 30 V; ts 200 ns. SPICE model: the widely published Fairchild/onsemi 2N3904 model, BF stepped

74lvc1g11.note: inputs 5 V tolerant at any VCC (VI 0 to 5.5 V); IOFF partial power-down

rp2350.src: RP2350 datasheet Table 1436 as quoted in docs/research/keyer-verification-and-key-input-network.md: VOH min 2.62 V, VOL max 0.5 V; erratum E9 pad leakage about 120 uA (typical, A2 stepping)

lm393.src: TI LM393 SLCS005AH (Apr 2025): VOL 400 mV max at 4 mA (25 C), 700 mV full range; IOH 0.1 nA typ at 5 V

gva84.src: Mini-Circuits GVA-84+ Rev. F: fixed +5 V operation, device 4.8/5.0/5.2 V, 85/108/130 mA, 0.058 mA/mV, gain 22.9/24.1/25.3 dB at 0.1 GHz, input max +13 dBm, Darlington (transient protected)
gva84.v_cut_note: E: I(V) = 0.058 A/V x (V - 3.14 V), the datasheet slope at 5 V extrapolated to zero current (3.14 V, about two InGaP base-emitter drops plus the internal resistors); soft-plus below

1n5711w.src: Diodes 1N5711W DS11015 Rev. 15-2 (Aug 2022), Electrical Characteristics: VF 0.41 V max at 1 mA, 1.00 V max at 15 mA; IR 200 nA max at 50 V; V(BR)R 70 V min; IFM 15 mA; CT 2.0 pF max. BOM row 14 part
1n5711w.fit: DD: SPICE diode through both VF maxima (Is 1.07 nA, N 1.05, Rs 36.9 ohm), a maximum-VF model; hot reverse leakage x 64 at about +60 K (E), 12.8 uA, taken analytically

cutoff_sinks.src: TS-012 section 8.1: the REQ-SYS-055 monostable, the REQ-SYS-180 backstop, the REQ-SYS-181 95 C trip and the cell 60 C trip are LM393 open-collector outputs (VOL 0.7 V max full range at 4 mA, IOH-LKG 20 nA); the REQ-SYS-092 VBUS inhibit is an open-collector or open-drain pull whose part the TS-005 remnant sets, modelled here as a 2N7002-class open drain (5.3 ohm, IDSS 10 uA hot)

lm2940_bus.src: LM2940-5 as a 5.0 V source, 4.75 to 5.25 V (TI SNVS769J 6.5 as TS-012 quotes it); 50 mohm and 5 uH for the regulator's loop response, 22 uF output capacitor (E)

f3.src: spurs-ts012.md F3: GVA-84+ supply through a ferrite bead and 22 uF; here placed upstream of the P-FET (bead 0.2 ohm + 1 uH, 22 uF, 10 mohm ESR)

t_on_ms.text: driver supply within 50 mV of its source after the later of PA_EN and TX_KEY (budget: 2 ms nominal lead, 0.5 ms in the interval-13 fallback; limit half of the fallback lead)

clamp_release_ms.text: clamp gate at most 0.3 V after the later of PA_EN and TX_KEY (before the ramp)

vgs_on_v.text: P-FET VGS while permitted (RDS(on) is specified at -4.5 V; -4.0 V keeps it at least 1.9 V beyond the -2.1 V threshold)

drop_mv.text: P-FET drop at the GVA-84+ current while permitted

inrush_a.text: P-FET peak current at turn-on (DMP3099L IDM 11 A, pulse <= 10 us)

bus_dip_mv.text: 5 V bus dip at driver turn-on (Q, error amplifier and monostables on the bus)

vgs_off_v.text: P-FET VGS in the key-up window (at most 0.3 V, against the lowest threshold magnitude 0.73 V, hot estimate)

vtx5_keyup_mv.text: driver supply in the key-up window (GVA-84+ draws no current below about 3.1 V)

t_off_ms.text: driver supply below 0.1 V after TX_KEY falls

clamp_gate_keyup_v.text: clamp gate in the key-up window (RDS(on) specified at 4.5 V; threshold at most 2.75 V)

vgg_keyup_mv.text: VGG in the key-up window, error amplifier wound to the rail in half the cases (module dead zone to about 2.3 V)

pre_permit_off.text: driver supply (V) while only one of PA_EN and TX_KEY is high (7 to 8 ms; 8 to 11 ms in the fallback): a single line does not power the driver

keyup_dbm_L1.text: REQ-TX-014 level in the key-up window, estimates (GVA-84+ unpowered 19.6 dB, module VGG-off 30 dB)

state_text.lead: lead-in before either line (t0 + 1 ms, CLK1 on, to the first of PA_EN and TX_KEY)
state_text.one: one line only (PA_EN only 7 to 8 ms; TX_KEY only 8 to 11 ms in the interval-13 fallback)
state_text.keyup: TX_KEY low, PA_EN high: between elements and through the hang time (REQ-TX-014 state)
state_text.end: PA_EN cleared at the end of the over, CLK1 still on, relay not yet released
